about_the_game:
Hey, handsome rebel! Here’s your bonus — a set of high-resolution static & animated wallpapers（some） from Rebellion GODSOUL!

All in glorious 4K! Includes themes like feet, ice cream, chocolate, and more!

Don’t forget to wishlist Rebellion GODSOUL! You’ll be notified when it launches — expected release on May 1st!

How to use: After downloading this DLC, go to your game install folder (e.g., H:\Steam\steamapps\common\GODSOUL\DLC_FreeWallpapers) to access the wallpapers!

Usage rights: You are welcome to use them for personal purposes, such as wallpapers, avatars, custom prints, videos, or sharing online.

You can also use these wallpapers for creative work, like making animated wallpapers or creating game mods.

Just don’t mass-sell them commercially on e-commerce platforms.

If possible, please credit Rebellion GODSOUL when you use them. That’d mean a lot to us ❤

As long as our dev team survives, we’ll keep bringing you more awesome wallpapers!

content_descriptors.notes: These wallpapers contain some revealing clothing or sexual innuendos, and the characters are all over 18 years old
